newsitem.title: UKRAINE: FORECAST-Ukraine Oct inflation under 2.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Ukraine Oct inflation under 2.0 pct.

text.p: Ukraine's October inflation rate will be close to September's rate of 2.0 percent, Deputy Prime Minister Viktor Pynzenyk said on Monday.
The Statistics Ministry said earlier that the country's inflation slowed to 2.0 percent in September from 5.7 percent in August.
"The September inflation figure is a bit surprise for me, since we expected higher inflation after the introduction of the new hryvnia currency in the first part of that month," Pynzenyk said.
Pynzenyk added that the government has maintained its annual inflation forecast at 45-48 percent, down from last year's 182 percent.
According to the Statistics Ministry, annual inflation in September stood at 34.8 percent, compared to 132.4 percent at the same time last year.
The draft budget, submitted to parliament for approval, has forecast annual inflation at 25 percent in 1997.
